meta.description: Position classification and style matching system

positionTypes.name: Closed Center
positionTypes.description: Pawns block center (d4/e4 vs d5/e5), play on wings
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Low aggression: maneuver, prepare breaks. High aggression: premature breaks backfire.

positionTypes.name: Open Center
positionTypes.description: Central pawns exchanged, open files/diagonals, piece activity key
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: High aggression thrives. Low aggression: solidify, trade into ending.

positionTypes.name: Fixed Pawn Structure
positionTypes.description: Pawn chain defines space, clear plans for both sides
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Match aggression to break timing. Prepared break = active. Unprepared = solid.

positionTypes.name: Fluid Pawn Structure
positionTypes.description: Multiple breaks possible, structure not defined, dynamic
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Active play rewards initiative. Solid play must define structure first.

positionTypes.name: Opposite-Side Castling
positionTypes.description: Kings on opposite wings, pawn storms, race positions
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: MUST play aggressively. Slow play loses. Even solid players must attack.

positionTypes.name: Same-Side Castling
positionTypes.description: Both kings same side, positional maneuvering, central play
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Full spectrum viable. Match to position structure.

positionTypes.name: Isolated Queen's Pawn (IQP)
positionTypes.description: Isolated d-pawn, dynamic piece play vs structural weakness
keyThemes: IQP side: piece activity, avoid trades, attack
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: IQP side: must be active (55+). Anti-IQP: solid blockade (0-35).

positionTypes.name: Hanging Pawns (c4/d4 or c5/d5)
positionTypes.description: Two pawns on adjacent files, dynamic but vulnerable
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Hanging pawns side: active (55). Against: blockade and attack (15-35).

positionTypes.name: Backward Pawn on Semi-Open File
positionTypes.description: Pawn cannot be protected by pawns, target on open file

positionTypes.name: Bishop Pair Advantage
positionTypes.description: Two bishops vs bishop+knight or two knights, open position favored
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Keep position open, avoid trades. Active play (35-55) maximizes value.

positionTypes.name: Opposite-Color Bishops (Middlegame)
positionTypes.description: Attacking potential, drawing tendency in endgame
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Middlegame: aggressive attack (55+). Endgame: solid (0-20) - it's likely drawn.

positionTypes.name: Lead in Development
positionTypes.description: More pieces developed, open position, time factor critical
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: MUST cash in aggressively. Every move counts. Solid play wastes advantage.

positionTypes.name: King Stuck in Center
positionTypes.description: Opponent king not castled, central files open, attacking target
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: ALL-OUT ATTACK. This is not a position for solid play.

positionTypes.name: Weak King Shelter
positionTypes.description: Pawns damaged (g/h/f files), king exposed, attacking target
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Attack aggressively. Solid play lets opponent consolidate.

positionTypes.name: Symmetric Position
positionTypes.description: Mirror position, small nuances decide, psychological
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Low aggression: outplay technically. High aggression: breaks symmetry poorly.

positionTypes.name: Material Imbalance
positionTypes.description: Queen vs 2 rooks, rook vs 2 minors, etc. - specific knowledge needed
positionTypes.aggressionAdvice: Side with activity: aggressive. Side with material: solidify and trade.

algorithm: Parse position features (pawn structure, king safety, piece activity, material)
Map to aggression range via bestStyles/worstStyles

quickReference.IQP: IQP side: active. Anti-IQP: solid blockade.
